description: Result Submission and Approval Workflow (Task 16): POST submit result, POST approve/reject (runs scoring engine creating ScoreEvents), POST open dispute, admin results page with four-tab layout, and ResultReviewCard component. Depends on FEAT-001 (assertMatchTransition) and FEAT-002 (calculateMatchScore, getDefaultConfig).
steps: Create apps/web/src/app/api/servers/[guildId]/matches/[matchId]/results/route.ts. Export POST (auth required — NOT withPermission, just createClient + dbUser lookup since players submit results). Auth: createClient(), get user, return 401 if none. Look up dbUser: prisma.user.findFirst({ where: { discordId: user.user_metadata?.provider_id ?? user.id } }) — 404 if not found. Body schema: z.object({ scorecardJson: z.array(z.object({ teamId: z.string(), placement: z.number().int().min(1), kills: z.number().int().min(0), penalties: z.number().optional() })).min(1), evidenceUrl: z.string().url().optional() }). Fetch match: prisma.match.findFirst({ where: { id: params.matchId, guildId: params.guildId }, include: { stage: { include: { tournament: { select: { id: true, guildId: true } } } }, participants: { include: { team: { select: { captainId: true } } } } } }) — 404 if not found. Import assertMatchTransition from @esports/tournament-engine. Only LIVE and AWAITING_RESULT are valid states for submission: if not LIVE and not AWAITING_RESULT return 409 { error: 'invalid_match_state' }. Authorization: check that dbUser.id equals one of the team captains in match.participants — return 403 { error: 'not_a_captain' } if not found. In prisma.$transaction: const sub = await tx.resultSubmission.create({ data: { matchId, submittedBy: dbUser.id, scorecardJson: body.scorecardJson, evidenceUrl: body.evidenceUrl, status: 'PENDING_REVIEW' } }); if match.status === 'LIVE': await tx.match.update({ where: { id: matchId }, data: { status: 'AWAITING_RESULT' } }); await tx.outboxEvent.create({ data: { guildId: params.guildId, type: 'RESULT_SUBMITTED', payloadJson: { matchId, submissionId: sub.id }, status: 'PENDING' } }). Return 201 { submission: { id: sub.id, status: sub.status } }.

Create apps/web/src/app/api/servers/[guildId]/matches/[matchId]/approve/route.ts. Export POST = withPermission(AppRole.REFEREE, async (req, { guildId, userId, params }) => { ... }). Body schema: z.object({ submissionId: z.string().cuid(), action: z.enum(['approve', 'reject']), reason: z.string().max(500).optional() }). Fetch submission: prisma.resultSubmission.findFirst({ where: { id: body.submissionId, matchId: params.matchId }, include: { match: { include: { stage: { include: { tournament: { select: { game: true, mode: true, guildId: true } } } } } } } }) — 404 if not found. Verify match.guildId === guildId — 403 if mismatch. For 'approve': import { getDefaultConfig, calculateMatchScore } from '@esports/game-rules'. Parse scorecardJson as PlacementRow[]. Call config = getDefaultConfig(tournament.game as any, tournament.mode as any). Call scores = calculateMatchScore({ config, placements: scorecardJson, matchId: params.matchId }). assertMatchTransition(match.status, 'COMPLETED') — return 409 if throws. In prisma.$transaction: await tx.scoreEvent.createMany({ data: scores.map(s => ({ matchId: params.matchId, teamId: s.teamId, type: 'MATCH_SCORE', points: s.points, kills: s.kills, placement: s.placement, createdBy: userId, status: 'active' })) }); await tx.resultSubmission.update({ where: { id: body.submissionId }, data: { status: 'APPROVED', reviewedBy: userId, reviewedAt: new Date() } }); await tx.match.update({ where: { id: params.matchId }, data: { status: 'COMPLETED', completedAt: new Date() } }); await tx.auditLog.create({ data: { guildId, actorId: userId, action: 'RESULT_APPROVED', targetType: 'ResultSubmission', targetId: body.submissionId } }); await tx.outboxEvent.create({ data: { guildId, type: 'RESULT_APPROVED', payloadJson: { matchId: params.matchId, submissionId: body.submissionId, scoreCount: scores.length }, status: 'PENDING' } }). For 'reject': tx.resultSubmission.update({ status: 'REJECTED', reviewedBy, reviewedAt, rejectionReason: reason }); tx.auditLog.create({ action: 'RESULT_REJECTED' }); tx.outboxEvent.create({ type: 'RESULT_REJECTED' }). Return 200 { ok: true }.

Create apps/web/src/app/api/servers/[guildId]/matches/[matchId]/dispute/route.ts. Export POST (auth required — createClient + dbUser, not withPermission). Auth + dbUser lookup same as results route. Fetch match scoped by { id: params.matchId, guildId: params.guildId }. Body schema: z.object({ reason: z.string().min(10).max(1000), evidenceUrl: z.string().url().optional() }). Valid states for dispute: AWAITING_RESULT or UNDER_REVIEW — return 409 { error: 'cannot_dispute' } otherwise. No captain check for disputes (any participant can raise). In transaction: tx.dispute.create({ data: { matchId, raisedBy: dbUser.id, reason, evidenceUrl, status: 'OPEN' } }); tx.match.update({ where: { id: matchId }, data: { status: 'DISPUTED' } }); tx.outboxEvent.create({ data: { guildId, type: 'DISPUTE_OPENED', payloadJson: { matchId, disputeId, reason }, status: 'PENDING' } }). Return 201 { dispute: { id } }.

Create apps/web/src/components/admin/ResultReviewCard.tsx. 'use client' component. Props: { guildId: string; submission: ResultSubmissionWithMatch; onReviewed: () => void }. Type ResultSubmissionWithMatch = { id, matchId, submittedBy, scorecardJson: PlacementRow[], evidenceUrl: string|null, status, createdAt, match: { number, scheduledStart, guildId } }. Render inside GlassCard: match number + scheduled time header; evidence link (if present); scorecard table with columns: Team ID (display first 8 chars), Placement, Kills, Penalties; Approve button (GlowButton variant='primary') and Reject button (GlowButton variant='destructive'). Approve: prompt for no reason, call POST .../approve with { submissionId: submission.id, action: 'approve' }. Reject: prompt for reason (required), call with { action: 'reject', reason }. Show loading state during fetch. Call onReviewed() on success. Show sonner toast on success/error.

Create apps/web/src/app/servers/[guildId]/admin/results/page.tsx. Server component. Auth + REFEREE role guard (AppRole.REFEREE — referees can review results). Fetch all ResultSubmission rows scoped via match.guildId: prisma.resultSubmission.findMany({ where: { match: { guildId: params.guildId } }, include: { match: { select: { id, number, scheduledStart, guildId, stage: { select: { tournamentId } } } } }, orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' }, take: 100 }). Serialize dates. Render client component ResultsPageClient (create inline in same file as a small 'use client' wrapper) that renders Radix Tabs: tabs = ['Pending', 'Under Review', 'Approved', 'Disputes']. Pending tab: submissions with status=PENDING_REVIEW. Under Review tab: status=PENDING_REVIEW (same as pending — matches go to UNDER_REVIEW status). Approved tab: status=APPROVED. Disputes tab: separately query prisma.dispute.findMany({ where: { match: { guildId } }, include: { match: { select: { number } } }, orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' } }). Each pending/under-review tab item renders a ResultReviewCard. Each approved/dispute item renders a simpler read-only summary card.
acceptance_criteria: pnpm --filter web type-check exits with code 0
POST results route returns 403 for non-captains
POST approve route creates ScoreEvent rows using calculateMatchScore from @esports/game-rules
POST dispute route updates match status to DISPUTED
Admin results page renders all four tabs
